summary: All requested requirements for product management functionality have been implemented. The diff shows complete implementation of admin products page, product edit modal, backend update/delete functions, React Query hooks, routing, and navigation updates. Price conversion between cents and INR is handled correctly. Image handling uses data URLs instead of file system uploads, which differs slightly from the original specification but is a valid approach for web applications.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module (backend/migration.mo) for data migration between canister versions
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention implementing a migration system or migration.mo file. This appears to be infrastructure code added beyond the scope of the requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Blob storage mixin integration (MixinStorage from blob-storage/Mixin)
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not request blob storage functionality or any storage mixin. This is visible in the backend/main.mo file with 'include MixinStorage()' and 'import MixinStorage "blob-storage/Mixin"'.

hallucinated_features.description: Image URL manual input field in ProductEditModal
hallucinated_features.reason: The modal includes a handleImageUrlChange function and likely a manual URL input field, which was not requested. REQ-39 only specifies file upload with conversion to data URLs or saving to public/assets/products/.
